 Chad Gable, Rey Fenix and Dragon Lee def. The Vanity Project 
 04:24 
 Chad Gable, Rey Fenix and Dragon Lee defeat The Vanity Project in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
The star-studded team of Chad Gable, Dragon Lee and AAA Cruiserweight Champion Rey Fenix took down the most decorated group in NXT, The Vanity Project.
Gable’s team was cruising until Drake hit an incredible moonsault double stomp, severely compromising the former Intercontinental Champion’s ribs.
Fenix tagged in and immediately regained the momentum for his side, hitting several incredible kicks and a huge moonsault that nearly ended the bout.
The Vanity Project found themselves in deep trouble as Gable locked in an Ankle Lock on Drake, Fenix put Ricky Smokes in a torture rack, and Dragon Lee hit Operation Dragon all simultaneously for the win.
 NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan def. Paige 
 03:20 
 Paige is revealed to be Kelani Jordan’s NXT Women’s Title Match opponent. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
Kelani Jordan overcame the stiffest test of her young career as she defeated legendary former NXT Superstar, Paige.
Paige was dominant and even hit Paige Turner, but the champion was resilient in kicking out.
The challenger counted the One of a Kind Split Legged Moonsault, but Jordan wisely locked in a rollup and escaped with her title in tow.
 Noam Dar & Romeo Moreno def. Hank & Tank to win the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic 
 03:27 
 Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno make history by winning the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
The 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic trophy belongs to Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno after an epic final.
The power game of Hank & Tank led to an early advantage, but the youngster Moreno threw caution to the wind with his gravity-defying leaps onto his opponents.
Hank & Tank seemingly had the match won after the signature tandem splashes, but Dar kicked out in spectacular fashion. Dar followed it up with an Ankle Lock on Walker, but Ledger saved his teammate.
Dar and Moreno continued their fast paced offense as they hit tandem Cross Rhodes before cracking Ledger with a perfect High-Low to win the Dusty Cup.
 00:50 
 Cody Rhodes presents the 2026 Dusty Cup trophy to Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
After the match, Cody Rhodes presented the duo with the coveted Dusty Cup.
 Cruz Montana def. Dion Lennox | Unsanctioned Match 
 04:08 
 Royce Keys and The 946 go to extreme lengths to help Cruz Montana beat Dion Lennox in an Unsanctioned Match. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
Cruz Montana got payback on Dion Lennox in a brutal Unsanctioned Match refereed by UFC star Michael Chandler.
Montana jumped Lennox before the bell could even ring, kicking off a violent match that featured steel chairs, tables, and other weapons.
After being suplexed through the wooden wall of the perch earlier in the bout, Lennox began refusing to listen to Chandler, allowing Montana enough time to recover to hit a rolling cutter and a huge dive to the outside.
Osiris Griffin and Cutler James arrived to help Lennox, but Royce Keys and The 946 appeared and proceeded to clean house, planting James through the announce table.
That move allowed Montana to Spin The Block, giving him the major win.
 John Cena meets Zilla Fatu in must-see moment 
 07:15 
 John Cena gives more details on the upcoming John Cena Classic. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 NXT Champion Grayson Waller def. CM Punk.  
 16:10 
 Grayson Waller defends the NXT Championship against CM Punk. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
Grayson Waller retained the NXT Championship thanks to an unexpected assist from Kevin Owens.
The Aussie Icon kept pace with The Best in the World, but it wasn’t long before Punk’s experience and fighting spirit began to weigh on the champion.
The challenger looked poised to win the NXT Title after a superplex, but his attempt at a GTS was thwarted by Kevin Owens who jumped up on the ring apron.
 01:50 
 Kevin Owens makes his presence felt in NXT by costing CM Punk the NXT Championship. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
Owens didn’t make contact with Punk but the distraction was enough to allow Waller to roll him up, pull the tights, and escape with the gold.
